```{r}

library(survey)
library(tidyverse)

faculty <- read.csv("trinity faculty.csv")
```

-   stratified sampling with each department as a stratum (41 in total and labeled in alphabetical order 1 through 41)

-   proportional allocation calculated for each and rounded to nearest whole number

    -    values rounded down to 0 were manually changed to 1 (insert justification)

```{r}
#| label: renaming-variables

faculty <- faculty |>
  rename(
    stratum = 'Stratum..',
    department = 'Dept.name',
    N_h = 'X..of.faculty',
    n_h = 'Rounded.allocation'
  ) |>
  arrange(stratum)
```

```{r}
#|label: create-facultyIDs

trin_faculty <- faculty |>
  rowwise() |>
  reframe(
    stratum = stratum,
    department = department,
    faculty_id = 1:N_h,
    n_h = n_h
  )
```

```{r}
#|label: stratified-random-sample

set.seed(215)

sample <- trin_faculty |>
  group_by(stratum, department) |>
  group_modify(~ slice_sample(.x, n = .x$n_h[1], replace = FALSE)) |> 
  #for julia: fyi this line of code debugged by chat
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(stratum, faculty_id)

sample
```
